name: Pieta ~Shiawase no Aoi Tori~
source:
In a desperate situation, two sisters strive to survive.

The Shōwa period has just begun.
With modernization as their aim, the central government dispatched an official along with his family to a mountain village. 
As a missionary himself, he worked hard to save the villagers from their misguided traditions, striving to guide them towards the light of the Gospel. 
Yet, living for centuries under the absolute authority of the Gohara family, the deeply traditional village society refused to accept the newcomers, instead giving their all to drive them out. 
As a result, the official and his wife fell ill, losing everything to the Gohara family. 
The remaining daughters, two sisters left behind, were taken in as servants by the Gohara household.
Yet there awaited them nought but a storm of hatred and jealousy.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=105861]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
绝境中，两姐妹努力求生。

昭和时代刚刚开始。为推动现代化，中央政府派遣一名官员及其家人前往山村。身为传教士的他努力让村民摆脱错误传统，引导他们走向福音之光。然而，在五原家数百年绝对权威下生活的传统村社拒绝接纳新人，并竭尽全力驱逐他们。结果，官员与妻子病倒，一切也被五原家夺走。留下的两个女儿被五原家收作佣人，但等待她们的只有憎恨与嫉妒的风暴。
